qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Norwegian domestic deposit and lending franchise (~30% market share) provides an insurmountable low-cost funding advantage and operational scale. Proven high ROE (13-18%) across cycles. Primary erosion risks include digital fintech disintermediation and macroeconomic commodity/oil shocks affecting Norwegian credit.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet Fortress). Dominant Norwegian retail and commercial bank with strong ~30% market share and low-cost deposit moat, but disqualified at Gate 6 due to inherent commercial fractional-reserve banking leverage (>10x assets/equity) and deposit duration/credit risk.
qualitative.evidence: DNB holds ~30% market share in Norwegian retail mortgages and corporate lending with strong ROE (15-18% in FY23-FY25, net income NOK 41.9B in FY25). However, as a commercial deposit bank, it operates with fractional-reserve leverage (assets/equity >10x) and wholesale debt funding, failing the Gate 6 non-bank fortress balance sheet requirement.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
